Deutsche Bank Accused of Facilitating Money Laundering and Sanctioned Oligarchs

An investigation by Newslaundry and Le Monde alleges that Deutsche Bank facilitated money laundering and the flow of funds for sanctioned oligarchs. Le Monde's reporting, in collaboration with partners, specifically details how the German banking giant allegedly dominated the market for euro-denominated payments in Colombia without conducting necessary checks, potentially enabling sexual exploitation and drug trafficking.
